dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature fitting a parabolic spline, characterized by at least three distinct mechanical notches of varying depth on the posterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium pixel radius; lacks acute or obtuse vertex definition.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep positive gradient of approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width to maximum vertical height ratio of approximately 1.4:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple irregular notches on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; several white linear and circular depigmented marks/scars visible on the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive distribution of small, white punctate spotting across the dark grey epidermal field.
